This manual describes the final clinician workflow for **Retinal Review Workbench**. It is intended for clinician onboarding, hospital/internal demonstration, clinical research workflow documentation, and software audit.

::: {.callout-warning title="WARNING — clinical scope"}
This software provides model-assisted evidence for clinician review. It does not autonomously establish diagnosis, disease truth, referral, or treatment decisions. Human review remains authoritative.
:::

## Two-minute workflow

1. In **Worklist**, select a case and complete **Confirm Image**.
2. In **Review**, inspect the retinal image and run optional analysis if the Model API is available.
3. Toggle or filter PRISM overlays as needed. No per-detection confirmation is required.
4. In **Clinician Review**, choose the final grade and select **Confirm DR Grade**.
5. In **Edit Annotations**, make only the corrections or additions needed, then select **Confirm Annotation** when the active annotation set is reviewed.
6. In **Datasets**, check **DR-ready** and **Lesion-ready** separately before export.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  W[Worklist] --> I[Confirm Image]
  I --> R[Review]
  R --> A[Optional AI assistance]
  R --> G[Confirm DR Grade]
  G --> E[Edit Annotations]
  E --> C[Confirm Annotation]
  C --> D[Dataset / next case]
```

::: {.callout-important title="IMPORTANT — three milestones"}
The three confirmation actions are case-level workflow milestones. ROI correction and removal are optional edits; they are not a queue of detections that must all be resolved.
:::
